definitions.explanation: Water that has been heated to or near its boiling point. Used in cooking instructions, food preparation, and safety warnings.

examples.japanese: {熱湯|ねっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}いで→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦カップ→カップ：01077_kappu⟧⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熱湯|ねっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧3{分|ぷん}⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: Pour boiling water into the cup noodles and wait three minutes.

examples.japanese: {熱湯|ねっとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧やけど⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful not to burn yourself with the boiling water.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on instant food packaging and in cooking instructions. Distinct from ⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧ (hot water), which can refer to water of any warm temperature. {熱湯|ねっとう} specifically means water at or very near 100°C.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱湯|ねっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to pour boiling water
- {熱湯|ねっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧: to bring water to a boil
- {熱湯|ねっとう}⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧: sterilization with boiling water
- {熱湯|ねっとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧: to blanch in boiling water
